Commentary.Commentary: India got a lead of exactly 200 runs as Ravichandran Ashwin wrapped up the tail with another five-wicket haul. Jadeja and Jayant Yadav both bowled well to give him good support. INDIA ARE BATTING AGAIN, they would be wanting to score quick runs and tire the England bowlers down. Broad has a sore feet and Ansari has a lower back issue. The pressure will be on England since they are also having Anderson returning from injury. Let's see how India bat. Stay tuned for their reply.

That ends a fighting effort from England! They were jolted early and were reduced to 80 for 5 before the 110-run stand between Jonny Bairstow and Ben Stokes ensured that they did not concede a huge lead. Both of them missed out on their tons and that could very well be the decisive moment in the game

OUT! Anderson gone first ball, England fail to avoid the follow-on, trail be a massive 200 runs but of all RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN GETS HIS 22ND TEST 5-FER! What a performance from the offie, yet again. Bowls a loopy delivery around middle, gets it to drift through the surface as Anderson gets back to punch it through the off side but misses and is rapped on the pads right in front of the stumps. Ashwin appeals and sees the finger going up. ENGLAND BOWLED OUT FOR 255!
JAMES ANDERSON is the last man in.

OUT! Ashwin has another! No reviews left which means Stuart Broad will have to walk back to the pavilion. Ash bowls a slider around middle and leg, skidding in with the angle. Broad gets back to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows and umpire Dharmasena gives it out. Replays show it would have gone on to miss the stumps. England still need 1 run to avoid the follow-on and trail by 200 runs!
Full and around middle and off, defended into the ground.
Drifting in as Broad covers the line to offer a straight bat.
Gives it a bit more flight around off, Broad is happy to defend it off the front foot to the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets forward and keeps it out in time.
Tossed up delivery around off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Full and fired around off, swept behind square for a single.
Around off, defended off the back foot.

Short and outside off, Broad looks to punch but gets it off the bottom part of the bat past Rahane at first slip who gives it a chase. Broad comes back for the second but Adil wanted the third one as well which was never there.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on!
Loopy around off, Adil looks to drive but gets it towards point off the outer half.
The batsman fails to make contact as it turned a long way.
Gives this one a bit more flight and gets it to drift furhter as Rashid looks to defend it but gets beaten again.
Flatter outside off, Rashid camps back to punch but gets beaten all ends up.
Full and fired around middle, Broad looks to defend this one from within the crease but inside edges past short leg for a single.
Floated delivery around off, driven towards point.
Gets behind the line and defends it down safely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Direct hit and he was gone! Short and outside off, Stuart punches it towards covers and sets off for a single. Jadeja from point charges towards the cherry, collects and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and replays show, Broad would have been a goner had that it. A risky single taken.
FOUR! That's creamed and 250 up for England! Loopy ball outside off, Broad stands grounded as he nails the drive through the gap at covers for a pleasing boundary.
Gives this one a bit more flight around off, Broad punches it past Jadeja at point and comes back for a double.
Makes a good stride forward to keep this out on the off side.

Flighted delivery around middle and leg, Broad looks to sweep but gets a top edge towards fine leg. The fielder in the deep comes forward to take that one but the ball falls well short of him. One run added to the total.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flattish around off, Broad looks to push it towards covers but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Slips it down the leg side, left alone by SB!
Gets down and sweeps it towards the leg side for nothing.
Floated delivery served around off, it's buried into the ground by Stuart.

FOUR! Edged! Short and flatter through the air outside off, Rashid once again looks to cut it but gets a thick outside edge past second slip as the ball runs down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Short and  turning in from over the wicket, Rashid looks to cut it off the back foot but ends up chopping it on the off side.
Tossed up ball outside off, Rashid lunges forward to defend but the ball kisses the outside part of the willow and runs down past first slip. A couple picked up.
Stays back and defends it from within the crease.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Broad comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat past Rahul at short leg for a single.
Around middle and leg, Broad gets down and across to paddle it down to fine leg. He misses and a good take by Saha by moving to his left.
Jayant Yadav into the attack now!
Tossed up around off, Rashid quickly brings his bat down and guides it with an open face behind point and comes back for a double.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Comes from around the wicket and serves a flatter ball on middle, Adil defends it by covering the line.
Prods forward to his loopy ball and keeps it out.
Quicker through the air around off, Rashid gets back and defends.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Rashid defends it into the ground.
Comes in from outside off, Broad defends it hurriedly from his crease.
Floated on middle, Broad looks to defend and does so well with his back leg stretching across.
Comes right forward and defends it back.
Outside off, Broad looks to play at it but is beaten.
Floated on off, Broad comes forward and defends it.
STUART BROAD is new man in.
Drinks break!

OUT! ANSARI FALLS! Floated on off, Ansari plays all over it and is rapped in front of the stumps. Jadeja appeals and the umpire has no doubts over it. Ansari comes down to have a chat and suggests there were possibly an edge and goes for the review. Replays confirm there was no bat there and he was hit on his front pad first. Ball Tracker shows three reds and Ansari has to go. Wonder why would you review that. The two noises were the ball hitting both the pads. England have lost both their reviews. Jadeja has his first wicket!
Ansari is adjudged LBW by Rod Tucker. He takes the review but looks to be a goner here...
Floated outside off, Rashid defends it with an inside edge towards Rahane at first slip.
Another one on off, turning in, kept out by Rashid.
Turns in from outside of, Rashid comes forward and keeps it out.
Bowls it outside off, turns away, Rashid comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Tossed up outside off, Rashid comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Heaved! Floated on middle, Rashid goes after it and heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That went off the inner half of the bat.
Rashid drives it through covers for a single to end the over.
Flatter outside off, goes straight, Rashid again lets it and the ball goes past the off stump.
Pushed towards covers by Rashid.
Changes the angle, bowls it on middle, from over the wicket, Rashid comes forward and defends it.
Outside leg, turns in, Rashid pads it away.
Floated on middle and leg, Rashid is happy to block it.
FOUR! Good shot! Ansari strides forward, takes it on the full and bunts it wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary to get off the mark.
Ansari slinks down the wicket and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Drops it short outside off, Ansari mistimes his punch towards covers.

Floated outside off, Ansari pokes at it with soft hands so that it does not carry to the first slip fielder.
Tossed up on middle, Ansari comes forward and blocks it.
Floated outside off, Ansari comes forward and defends it.

Goes over the wicket, bowls it on middle, Rashid keeps it out.
Rashid gets in line and keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, driven to silly point.

NOT OUT! What happened there? Landed on off, Ansari comes forward and looks to defend. The ball goes towards short cover who takes the catch and appeals. The umpires come together to refer it upstairs. The replays confirm it was a bump ball. Ansari survives!

Drama out there. A catch has been taken at short cover and the Indians feel they have got their man. Dharmasena feels it was bumped and the hence, the soft signal is not out. It is referred upstairs...
Ansari comes forward and defends it well.
Zafar Ansari is the next man in, replacing Ben Stokes! Remember, he isn't fit but still walks out to bat.

OUT! Drama as Stokes' review goes in vain! Floated on middle and off, Stokes comes forward to defend but is hit on his pads. The silly point collects the ball and joins the appeal. There is a loud noise for an lbw and Kumar Dharamasena upholds the appeal. Stokes comes down and has a word with Rashid and goes for the review. Replays are not conclusive enough to show that there was inside edge as Stokes had played that with his bat and pad together. It stays with the on-field call of out for an lbw. Three reds and that means Stokes has to go after a superb knock. Cook has a grim look on his face. Stokes slams his bat down as he reaches the dressing room. Even if they went with the inside edge, the catch was completed so he would have been given out caught as well. Nevertheless, a valiant knock by him. England still trail by 230 runs.

Ben Stokes is ruled out LBW but he opts for the review after having a word with Rashid. Looks close to the naked eye. Is there an inside edge? Even if there is, the catch is completed at silly point. Let's wait and see what the TV umpire feels.
Floated on off, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
Stays back and works it towards mid-wicket off his crease.

Landed outside off, spins in, Stokes looks to defend but is hit on his body and the ball falls towards short leg.
Shorter outside off, Stokes comes across and defends it.

Loud shout for an lbw but not given! Floated outside off, Rashid gets across and looks to defend but is hit on his back leg. A loud appeal but the umpire says no. The impact was outside off and Saha suggested the same and hence no review from India.
Rashid is right forward and defends it well.
Outside off, Rashid looks to defend but is beaten. There is a noise but it is of the bat hitting the ground.
Rashid comes forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Rashid comes forward and defends it with an outside edge towards second slip.

Shorter outside off, Stokes punches it through mid on for a single.

BRAVE LEAVE! Floated outside off, comes in a long way, Rashid leaves it but the ball just shaves the off stump. That was not that far from the stumps. A risky thing to do that against Jadeja.
Rashid comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.

Good length outside off, Stokes defends it watchfully.
EDGED! A touch short outside off, Stokes bottom edges his cut towards the keeper.
Length outside off, Stokes comes forward and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! POWERED! Shorter outside off, Stokes gets under it and hammers it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of disdain.

FOUR! Rashid is not helping Umesh! Good length on middle, Rashid gets on the top of it and rolls it through backward square leg for a boundary. Kohli is changing the field now.

Ouch! Shorter length outside off, Rashid takes his eyes off that one and fends it back down the wicket.
FOUR! SWEET! Fuller outside off, Rashid comes forward and opens the face of the bat through cover-point for a lovely boundary. That was lovely timing.
Outside off on a length, Rashid comes forward and defends it.

Fuller outside off, hint of away swing, Rashid drives it towards covers off his crease.
Outside off, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on middle and leg, Stokes fails to clip it through.
Angled on a length on the body, Rashid works it in front of the short leg fielder for a single. KL Rahul was a touch late to react to it as the ball went off the hip and then past short leg.
Bowls it on the pads, Stokes defends it off an inside edge which goes onto the pads and then down to the fine leg region for a single. Mild appeal turned down.

Good length outside off, punched towards covers off his crease.

Fuller outside off, Rashid keeps it out in time.

Fuller and angling into the body, Stokes clips it towards square leg for a single. That went off the bat and then the pad as the ball swung in late. Stokes slips at the non-striker's end and that prevents the second.
The SECOND NEW BALL is taken.

UMESH YADAV to bowl from the other end.

Welcome back for the second session of play. India have not taken the new ball for now as they have got the older ball reversing. Will it get them wickets? Let's see. India begin with MOHAMMED SHAMI. BEN STOKES and ADIL RASHID are out to continue batting. Will they look to play their shots rightaway or will they look to bat out time as well? Stay tuned for all the action.
DAY 3.... SESSION 2....

Stokes and Bairstow shared a 110-run stand before a wicket fell towards the fag end of the session. Bairstow was cleaned up by one that swung in very late for a hard working 53. Stokes is still out there and with the deficit still 264 runs, England will want him to eat into it as much possible. India will aim to take the remaining wickets soon and get a huge lead. The pitch is starting to misbehave a lot more but it is still a good one to bat and India will want to get batting sooner. Do join us in a while for the second session.

A very good session for England! They scored 88 runs in the session losing just the one wicket. India began the day being a bit over enthusiastic. There were overthrows, a review was taken desperately as the pair of Stokes and Bairstow did not offer many opportunities. There was one from Stokes when Saha failed to stump him, he was on 21 then. Both of them registered their respective fifties and mixed caution with aggression to frustrate the Indians further.
A low full toss outside off, Stokes is rock solid as he defends it towards covers. THAT IS LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Short and down the leg side, Stokes moves inside and leaves it alone.
Low full toss, tailing back in, blocked towards the off side.
Short of a length ball on middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
This one nips back in, Rashid gets across and flicks it towards short leg.
Good length ball on off, pitched right up there. Rashid defends it with soft hands.
Second new ball is available now. But the Indians might take it after lunch. The reviews have been refreshed as well...
Quicker through the air around middle, defended to the leg side.
Floated ball around off, BS plunges forward and defends it down into the ground.
Hangs back in defense, Ben Stokes.

Fuller and nipping back in after hitting the deck. Tashid tries to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.

OUT! Umesh Yadav provides the much-needed breakthrough! Anil Kumble in the dressing room is applauding, looks a happy man. It's full and angling into the batsman at 142 kph, Bairstow looks to clip it across the line but misses as the ball brushes the pads and deflects on to the stumps. Yadav jumps and then punches the air in joy. A vital 110-run stand has been broken and England still need 66 to avoid the follow-on.

Plunges forward and blocks it out solidly.

UMESH YADAV returns for a bowl. India will be a touch desperate for a wicket.
12th Test fifty for Jonny Bairstow. Brings up the 100-run stand as well.

FOUR! Jonny Bairstow gets to his fifty as well. Another impressive knock this from the English keeper. Full and outside off, Bairstow looks to drive it through the off side but gets an outside edge through gully for a boundary.

Stays back in the crease and defends it with a straight bat.
8th Test fifty for Ben Stokes!

There is it, a deserving half century for Ben Stokes! Flatter ball outside off, Stokes gets back and punches it through covers for a single. Gets a standing ovation from his mates. He will know the work is not done yet.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

In the air... falls just short! Sends it slower through the air around off, Jonny prods forward and looks to flick it through the on side. It goes aerially towards short mid-wicket where Kohli dives full length to his left but it falls just short.

Stumping chance missed! Floated on middle and off, turns away, Stokes looks to drive but is beaten all ends up. Saha fumbles a touch and fails to stump Stokes who lost his balance. The ball too pops out of his hands. Crucial chance missed?

Turns it through square leg for a single.
Bairstow comes forward and turns it towards short mid-wicket. Kohli  stationed there scores a direct hit but no harm done.

Pitched up outside off, driven nicely towards mid off form his crease.
Fuller outside off, Bairstow looks to drive but gets it off the inside half of the bat down the wicket.

NOT OUT! Poor review from India! Floated on off, Bairstow looks to sweep from outside off and gets it down to the fine leg region. A desperate review from India? A single taken. Both reviews gone for India.
Is there pad first? Ashwin thinks it is and hence, India take a review. Bairstow is the man in question...

Slants it on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a couple of runs. Bairstow called Stokes for the second there. There was a chance at the non-striker's end as Stokes didn't expect the second. Jadeja from fine leg threw at the bowler's end but it was a touch wide.

Game time! BEN STOKES and JONNY BAIRSTOW come out to bat for England. Will they attack or bat out time today? Oh dear! What happened there? Bairstow was coming out to bat, but seems to have done his ankle and is struggling to walk. He has to walk back in the dressing room. He gets some medical attention but is back out in the middle. He does not look that fit and is hobbling. No easy singles then? England will want to him to bat though. India begin with UMESH YADAV. Here we go...

Ravichandran Ashwin and Jayant Yadav have been amongst the wickets and a lot more will be expected off them. Will India enforce the follow-on in case they get a chance? England already have two bowlers struggling with fitness and India might not rule out looking to tire the rest of the bowlers and also give their bowlers a rest. But that's all for later. How things go in the first session could be decisive. Stay tuned for all the action of the day.

After putting up a massive total on board, the Indian spinners ran through the England batting line-up to have them reeling at 80 for 5. The pair of Ben Stokes and Jonny Bairstow has steadied them a bit but they will know their work is far from done. Their first aim will be to avoid the follow-on. The pitch though might be the one which has the most impact.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of the second Test between India and England from the Dr. Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium, Visakhapatnam. Phew, the deficit for England right now is as long as the name of the stadium, a whopping 352 runs and they have a lot of catch up to do.
DAY 3, SESSION 1....

England are still 352 runs behind and their first task will be to avoid the follow-on. They need a big partnership here. Let's see how they respond on a wicket which has started to turn and the odd one staying low. India will look to bowl England out as soon as possible tomorrow. Don't forget, the tourists bat deep so they will bank on their lower order. Join us back tomorrow then to catch the day 3 action at 0930 IST, should be an entertaining day of Test cricket. Until then, goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Terrific day for India! They're well on top in this second Test! First they managed to post 450-plus on the board, thanks to some lower order contributions and then picked up five wickets as well of England. The visitors didn't get off to a good start as they lost Cook early when Shami bowled a peach. They kept on losing wickets but Root held one end up. Ashwin and Jayant Yadav ran through the batting line-up and then Root lost his control too, getting out after his fifty. Since then, Bairstow and Stokes batted cautiously and avoided further damage.

DAY 2... SESSION 3 ....

There is a lot of work left, with the trail a massive 421 runs. England will know they have their task cut out. India will hope their spinners come into play more with the older ball and maintain their grip on the game. Do join us in a while for the final session of play.

An even session for both the teams! England did not allow India to score that many runs after the lunch and Rashid wrapped up the tail in a jiffy. OUT! BOWLED 'EM! This is a peach! Good length ball on middle and off, nice movement there, Cook tries to defend it off his back foot but misses it completely. Reminds me of a delivery which Ryan Harris bowled to him during the 2013-14 Ashes series.
